title: Tri-agent synthesis corrections after Gemini/Ditto inversion audit
rule_8: Remediation not started. Standing order is sequenced. Explicit GO required before any product patch.

corrections.issue: In-process snapshot time-travel is falsified. score_snapshots.py:319-320 refuses a second write_full_universe_snapshot submit while _write_future is running. The scheduler repeats that guard at 595-606 and, while the future is active, only registers a completion callback (649-650). os.replace runs inside the future before the next tick can start. A second process on the same volume is outside this falsification. The confirmed defect is staleness drift: line 228 stamps written_at at build completion onto a subnet set chosen before the loop (276-280), so a late orphan looks fresh and can hold C-014's fresh path for SCORE_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_SECONDS (7200).

soul_map_io.py:116-136 returns the mutated blob after except Exception: pass skips _cache_put. Later read_soul_map sees the pre-mutation cache or file. The docstring's always-sees-new-data sentence applies to successful writes only (107-108). The lie is the return value, not a naked raise.

price_fetcher.py:308-356 plus _save_json 70-76 is an unlocked whole-file replace. Different netuids drop each other's new keys. The same netuid is not safe: the last replace can store unavailable over a good candle block. Unavailable is retained for CACHE_TTL_SECONDS (default 300) at lines 313-314. Line 316 is not the eviction check.

server.py:610-611 overwrites Cache-Control for paths in _CACHE_PATHS, including the handler no-store at 1693. fly.toml:66 sets HOMEPAGE_SHELL_CACHE_SECONDS=60, so the 45-vs-60 default collision is the unset-env case, not the live header value.

expert_display.py has no signal_votes.get('consensus'). Signal override is leading_expert_from_signals (62-72) then the early return at 124. Tie-break max(score, name) at lines 72 and 108 prefers the alphabetically later expert name. Day Lens removal would not make the displayed leader equal the selected subnet.

severity_by_frequency: 1. Price-cache lost update and 300s unavailable retention. No exception required.
2. Homepage no-store replaced with public max-age on every / response, including the emergency shell.
3. Late snapshot publish with a fresh written_at and the subnet set from build start. Single-flight. Not a newer-cycle overwrite.
4. Soul-map return value lies only when json.dump or os.replace throws.
5. Day-pick attribution (Day Lens, signal override, alphabetical tie-break). Display fact, not silent data loss.
remediation_sequence: 1. Homepage: if the handler set Cache-Control, keep it. Do not change the 45/60 defaults.
2. Price cache: one file lock around read-modify-replace in fetch_ohlcv and _bust_cache_ttl. Do not keep unavailable for the full 300s. One two-netuid test.
3. Snapshot: keep single-flight. Stamp build_started_at or refuse os.replace when abandoned and the on-disk file is newer. No timeout increase.
4. Soul map: on I/O failure return the pre-mutation blob and log. No new exception until callers are audited.
5. Display: documentation of attribution, not a data-loss patch.
6. Read-only extract of pick_scheduler.py:322-328 and predictions_store.py before any patch there.
verified_by: Gemini and Ditto claims kept only where the pin bytes held
